newsitem.title: UK: Energy Group extends gain on Goldman comment.
newsitem.headline: Energy Group extends gain on Goldman comment.

text.p: Energy Group Plc shares rose sharply for a second day on Thursday, continuing to benefit from positive comments on the stock from Goldman Sachs on Wednesday, market-makers said.

The stock was up 14p at 503-1/2 by 1020 GMT in volume of 1.6 million shares, after on Wednesday rising 18p -- rebounding from the low of 463p set on March 21 following its demerger from Hanson Plc last month.
"It is just a continuation of yesterday's gains," said one dealer. Goldman added the stock to its "recommended" list from a previous "outperform" rating and set a "fair value" price target of 597p.
